name: Purchasing
description: Business domain covering how Adventure Works Cycles buys parts and other goods from vendors: vendors, the products they supply, purchase orders and shipping methods.

name: Vendor
description: A company from whom Adventure Works purchases parts or other goods. A vendor has addresses and employees to contact.

name: Vendor Product
description: The arrangement under which a vendor supplies a product to Adventure Works, including the units of measure in which it is ordered.

name: Purchase Order
description: An order placed with a vendor to buy goods. It records the general purchase order information: the vendor, the employee who placed it, the shipping method and the order totals.

name: Purchase Order Line
description: An individual product, in a given quantity, that is part of a specific purchase order.

name: Ship Method
description: A shipping company and service level used to deliver goods, both to Adventure Works on purchase orders and from Adventure Works on sales orders.
